info.name: qTest Manager API Version 3.0 Attachment API

params.name: projectId
params.description: ID of the project

params.name: type
params.description: Its valid values include releases, builds, requirements, test-cases, test-steps, test-logs or defects

params.name: ids
params.description: List of object IDs (of the same type as specified in the parameter above), separated by commas

params.name: author
params.description: ID of the user who created the attachment

params.name: createdDate
params.description: Its format is: {operator} {createdDate in timestamp or UTC} The operator can be one of the following values: lt: less than the given date gt: greater than given date eq: equal to the given date le: less than or equal to the given date ge: greater then or equal to the given date

params.name: pageSize
params.description: The result is paginated. By the default, the number of objects in each page is 100 if this is omitted. You can specify your custom number (up to 999) in this parameter

params.name: page
params.description: By default, the first page is returned but you can specify any page number to retrieve attachments

items.docs: To query for attachments of Releases, Builds, Requirements, Test Cases, Test Logs, Test Steps or Defects
